item.title: Hacktron Breaches OpenAI Monorepo Using Claude AI
item.description: Hacktron’s trio leveraged Claude Opus 4.8 and 5 to hijack OpenAI employee accounts, slip a pull request into the secret Monorepo through Discourse.

item.title: BGP Hijack Delivers Malware Through Softaculous Updates
item.description: A coordinated BGP hijack on Hetzner’s routing let attackers spoof Softaculous IPs, pushing malicious updates that infected many web‑hosting environments.
